mission.description: Fly from the base at (-8652, -16548) to the destination at (4105, 16344). Avoid all restricted zones and obstacles (Z1 [Jack Northrop Field Hawthorne Municipal Airport (KHHR, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z2 [Los Angeles International Airport (KLAX, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [Santa Monica Municipal Airport (KSMO, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [Hollywood Burbank/Bob Hope Airport (KBUR, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z5 [Long Beach International Airport (KLGB, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z6 [Van Nuys Airport (KVNY, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]), including the straight paths between waypoints. Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
